tasks.final_text: The National Museum of Galle (Galle National Museum) is one of the national museums of Sri Lanka.  It is located in the oldest remaining Dutch builsing in the Galle fort, Galle, a single storey colonnaded Dutch building built in 1656 as the commissariat store for the Dutch garrison at the fort.

I recently ate some risotto that I made at home. I sauteed an onion, and then added the rice. I slowly incorporated chicken stock until the rice was cooked. Then I dumped a bunch of parmesean cheese and added some cold butter. It was so good. I also seared a steak to go along with it, and had a nice side salad. Perfection in a single meal is hard to achieve.
